description: Source code for a SwiftUI view 'SystemRunSettingsView' and its related models and components, managing execution approval settings within a macOS application.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable model managing execution approval settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlists, and skill bins management.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes agent list and settings for the selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of available agents.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Sets the current agent and reloads its specific settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads security and allowlist settings for a specified agent.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates the security setting for the current context.

methods.name: setAskFallback
methods.description: Sets the fallback security mode when prompts are unreachable.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skills and refreshes skill bins accordingly.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new pattern to the allowlist after validation.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry with validation.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an entry from the allowlist.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Fetches an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Determines if a string matches the path pattern criteria.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Refreshes the list of skill bins if auto-allow is enabled.
